name: The Iron Fairies Bali
description: is a whimsical, high-end nightlife venue in Seminyak known for its magical, fantasy-themed design inspired by an iron foundry and a story about iron fairies. It combines decadent cocktails, live music (ranging from R&B to funk), and DJ sets in an enchanting setting filled with ironwork, steampunk decor, and intimate cabaret moments. It is designed by award-winning designer Ashley Sutton.
